include(GoogleTest)

# ── Test executable ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The list below is generated by update_cmakelists.sh (run by `make`):
# do not edit it by hand.
add_executable(defender_tests
        # <TESTS>
        test_enemy_definitions.cpp
        test_enemy_factory.cpp
        test_level.cpp
        test_map_generator.cpp
        test_player.cpp
        test_smoke.cpp
        test_towers.cpp
        test_waves.cpp
        # </TESTS>
)

target_link_libraries(defender_tests
    PRIVATE
        defender_lib
        GTest::gtest_main
)

# Automatically register discovered tests with CTest
gtest_discover_tests(defender_tests)
